# dsh-model-picker
A two-pane model picker for DeepSeek Harness. It replaces the model menu that the composer opens fro
m the model pill — a long drilled list you have to click through provider by provider — with one dia
log: every model searchable on the left, everything known about the selected one on the right.
中文说明见下方 中文。
## What it changes
The composer's model seat (`conversation.input.model`) normally opens the shipped drilled menu: a se
arch field, then one folder per provider that you step into and back out of, one model at a time. Th
is plugin takes that seat over at a lower slot priority and renders its own picker instead:
| Before | After |
| A drilled list; you open a provider, pick, and go back for another | One dialog with every provide

r visible at once |
| Only the model name per row | Provider, name, capability tags and favorites to

gether |
| Nothing about the model itself | Capacity, capabilities, reasoning levels and actions on

the right |
| No favorites or recents | Both pinned above the provider groups |
The trigger keeps its place in the tool row and still shows the current model name; only what it ope
keeps its place in the tool row and still shows the current model name; only what it opens changes.
**Left pane**

- Search across model names, provider names and capability tags.
- Grouped list: favorites and recen
tly used sit at the top, open by default; every group — those two included — collapses from its head

er, and provider groups start closed. Each header carries a model count.
- Each group header carries
a provider mark: a small tile whose hue is derived from the provider id, so the same provider alway
s looks the same. Harness exposes no provider icon, so this is a generated anchor rather than a vend
or logo. Rows carry text only — the mark is stated once per group instead of once per model — and ro

w text is indented to line up with the heading label.
- Keyboard: `↑` / `↓` to move, `Enter` to appl

to line up with the heading label.
- Keyboard: `↑` / `↓` to move, `Enter` to apply, `Esc` to close.
**Right pane**

- Model name with a favorite star, and `provider · providerId` underneath.
- Capacity: context windo

w and output cap.
- Capabilities: text / image input, reasoning.
- Reasoning effort chips, when the

model declares levels.
- Description.
- Actions: apply to this session, set as deployment default, d

vels.
- Description.
- Actions: apply to this session, set as deployment default, details, model ID.

## Where the data comes from
Every value is whatever the model's own provider reports through the Harness `llm` service — `llm.li
stModels()` and `llm.resolveModelInfo()`. Nothing is inferred, and no second source is consulted.
That has one consequence worth stating plainly: **no price is shown.** Harness's provider interface
exposes no cost field at all — its own adapter source says "the harness never reads pi-ai's cost met
adata" — so there is nothing truthful to display under "price". Rather than borrow a list price from
some other vendor that happens to sell a model with the same name, the detail card explains that th
e model carries no price data. If you need actual rates, use your provider's invoice.
The same rule applies to capacity. A context window or output cap appears only when the route or its
model entry declares one; an undeclared model shows no number instead of a guessed default.
Capability tags follow your configuration. A model declared with `input: [text, image]` shows `visua
l`; a model declared with only `id` and `name` shows text, because that is what the schema's `DEFAUL
T_INPUT` reports. If a model supports images but shows text, add the declaration to your provider co
orts. If a model supports images but shows text, add the declaration to your provider configuration.

The command writes `dsh-model-picker` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in your profile's `package.json`. Rel
oad the page once after installing.
## Requirements

- A DeepSeek Harness install with the Web client.
- The shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-se
lection` package, which provides the `modelDirectories` Client service this picker reads its model l
ist from. Without it the plugin stays dormant and the stock menu renders.
## Configuration
None. The plugin has no options: it reads the provider catalog Harness already resolved, and stores
its own preferences under `$DSH_HOME/model-picker/` (default `~/.dsh/model-picker/`).
| File | Contents |

| `model-picker-prefs.json` | Favorites and the last 12 recently used models |
| `client-errors.log`
| Client-side crash reports, written only if the picker throws |
Deleting the directory resets favorites and recents.
## Hot reload
The UI half (`client.js`) is hot-reloaded by the shipped `dsh-client-hmr` transport: save the file a
nd the open page swaps the plugin in about a second, no restart. The Host half (`index.js`) is a Nod
e plugin and needs an app restart.
## Development
The package is plain ES modules — no build step, no bundler, no client package imports. Two entry po
ackage is plain ES modules — no build step, no bundler, no client package imports. Two entry points:
- `index.js` — Host half. Registers the `/api/model-picker/*` routes (`meta`, `prefs`, `report`, `de

fault`), all fenced to loopback callers.
- `client.js` — Client half. Registers the seat over the `c
onversation.input.model` slot and draws the dialog.
The browser half is loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` and may only `req
uire` `react`, `react-dom` and `react/jsx-runtime`.

### 依赖

- 带 Web 客户端的 DeepSeek Harness。
- 官方自带包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`，它提供 `modelDirect
ories` 客户端服务，本插件的模型列表来自那里。缺少它时插件保持沉默，官方菜单照常显示。
